_doc: #1939 The API accounts of Cloud SuperIntel, declared in app data (public: names and references only). Models > API lists these first, then the private rows of apis.json (fleet-private, the sample rows while it is not served). NEVER a key, token or secret value here: `key_ref` names WHERE the secret lives (gateway environment name, vault or Secret Manager name), never the secret itself (test-superintel-agents.sh refuses a secret-shaped value). `status_key` is the gateway's /health.agents key the live status reads; absent = the account is not behind the gateway (status: not deployed). `cost` true = the row links to the Cost window.

accounts.label: OpenRouter
accounts.auth: API key (sent as a bearer by the gateway)
accounts.key_ref: Gateway environment OPENROUTER_API_KEY (my-ai-api, from the fleet vault); the image flow reads the OpenRouter row of Cloud Account's private store per send
accounts.used_by: Hermes, Goose, DeepSeek Harness and the OpenRouter models; image in and out

accounts.label: Claude Code
accounts.auth: Subscription login of the claude CLI (OAuth), no API key
accounts.key_ref: claude-superset-api on oci-apps holds the CLI login; the gateway reaches it through CLAUDE_CLI_BASE_URL

accounts.label: Google AGY
accounts.key_ref: GCP Secret Manager names agy-oauth-client-id, agy-oauth-client-secret, agy-cookie-secret, agy-allowed-email (not loaded yet, ticket #1432)
accounts.used_by: The Google AGY agent (Cloud Run agy, us-central1)
